mentions.name: Multiplayer Open World City Game
mentions.description: A multiplayer, open world game where players can jump to any city, walk around, see businesses, and chat with other players. Resources such as the map are loaded on demand and garbage collected, which has been a key technical challenge.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have spent the last six months or so on a multiplayer, open world game. The idea is you can jump to any city, walk around, see businesses and chat with others.
